profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Garmin
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in embedded, mobile, and desktop application development.

Languages: Java, Kotlin, C++, C#, Python, HTML, and SQL
Frameworks: Android SDK, WPF, and Bulma

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed an Android application that allows boat captains to communicate with scuba divers.

Built upon an existing desktop application to deliver an expandable test suite that evaluates wireless networking between devices used for scuba diving.

Technology used: Java, Android SDK, C#, and WPF.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Streamlined the aviation mapping update process by developing a database-driven desktop application.

Created a command-line program that parses batch file scripts and inserts the equivalent functionality into a database utilized by the desktop application.

Technology used: C#, SQL, and WPF.

educations.schoolName: University of Kansas - School of Engineering

volunteerExperiences.description: Progressed through the Scouting program to the rank of Eagle and currently serve as an adult leader.

30+ Volunteer Hours

Uplift Organization is a mobile street outreach for the homeless of Kansas City. Three nights a week, we take four Sprinter vans loaded with food, clothing, and other essential supplies out to the homeless.

projects.title: Terra
projects.description:
Developed a soon-to-be released Android application that helps users establish a mindfulness habit.

Technology used: Kotlin, Android SDK, Material Design, and InstaBug.

projects.title: Reddit Climbing Route Bot
projects.description:
Implemented a Reddit bot that identifies submissions containing pictures of rock climbing routes and publishes comments with information about the corresponding route.

Technology used: Python, Reddit API, Selenium, and Beautiful Soup
